name: Ticket booth
adds: Visitors buy their tickets here; stand behind the counter to sell them

name: Carousel
adds: The first ride: visitors climb on, and it goes round when every horse is taken or when you pull its lever

name: Candy floss cart
adds: Sweets for the visitors (+10% visitors); stand behind the cart to serve

name: Benches
adds: Somewhere to sit: visitors wait 30% longer in line

name: Bumper cars
adds: The Midway's first ride: six cars to drive and bump, launched from its lever

name: Ticket seller
adds: Sells tickets at the booth for you, and candy floss when the booth is quiet

name: Supply shed
adds: The delivery truck drops sugar, buns and prizes here; carry them to the stalls. Every sale pays 10% more

name: Ride operator
adds: Launches the carousel: when it's full, or when the first rider has waited a while

name: Ring-toss booth
adds: A throw for a plush prize; it needs prizes from the shed

name: Mechanic
adds: Fixes rides that break down (worn rides break down as they stop; stand at the lever to fix one yourself)

name: Teacups
adds: Kiddie Corner's second ride: four big cups that spin (+15% visitors)

name: Burger stand
adds: Burgers for hungry visitors; it needs buns from the shed

name: Midway vendor
adds: Serves at the ring-toss booth and the burger stand

name: Snack runner
adds: Carries sugar, buns and prizes from the shed to the stalls

name: Park sign and lights
adds: A big lit sign (+30% visitors), and lights all round the park: the evenings begin

name: Janitor and bins
adds: Bins along the paths mean less litter, and the janitor sweeps up the rest

name: Sky swings
adds: Lakeside's first ride: twelve chairs that fly out as it spins

name: Bus stop
adds: Tour buses bring a crowd at a time

name: Paddle boats
adds: Swan boats round the lake, with a dock hand to send them off

name: Haunted house
adds: A spooky dark ride that keeps running in any weather

name: Mascot
adds: Starry cheers up the longest line (people wait longer) and poses for photos

name: Cashier
adds: Collects the cash piles for you
